evals.prompt: Haz triage del issue ENG-104 en Linear. El ticket solo dice 'Soporte de exportación a CSV'.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the issue through the Linear MCP (get_issue), notices it has no description, explores the local codebase read-only to find the existing billing or reporting modules, drafts the 7-section spec (Goal, Constraints, Rules, Context, Scope, Metadata, Questions) with the English headings, and asks the user for explicit confirmation before calling save_issue. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Revisa el issue #89 de GitHub. Tiene estas notas: 'Vive en backend (Edge Function Deno o Postgres), nunca cliente. Días hábiles vs calendario (1 mes no son 30 días). Estimación: 16 h · Fase F4 · Ventana: 16-19 nov 2026'.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the issue with gh issue view, extracts the architectural constraints (backend required, client only consumes), the business rules (business vs calendar days) and keeps the estimate (16 h), delivery window (Nov 16-19) and phase (F4) intact in the Metadata section. It inspects the local repo and asks for confirmation before updating the issue on GitHub. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: I have a requirement for Jira but no direct integration set up. Help me refine the retention metrics calculation.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects there is no Jira integration, explores the local code, produces the 7-section spec, asks for confirmation and saves it to docs/specs/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md, also showing the Markdown block ready to paste into Jira.

evals.prompt: Explore this Notion requirement and get it ready for planning: https://www.notion.so/acme/Exportar-reportes-a-PDF-1a2b3c4d5e6f
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the page with notion-fetch, explores the repo read-only, builds the 7-section spec, shows it and asks for confirmation before writing it into the same page with notion-update-page. It does not create a local .md and ends by suggesting idd-plan.
